 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if not pts:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in pts), max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in pts), max(c for r,c in pts)
    # The enclosing color is the color on the object's perimeter; the inset color
    # is used to extend that perimeter outward by the frame thickness.
    frame = grid[r0][c0]
    inset = next((grid[r][c] for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1) if grid[r][c] != frame and grid[r][c] != 0), frame)
    t = min(r for r,c in pts if grid[r][c] != frame) - r0 if any(grid[r][c] != frame for r,c in pts) else 0
    pad = max(1,t)
    for r in range(max(0,r0-pad), min(h,r1+pad+1)):
        for c in range(max(0,c0-pad), min(w,c1+pad+1)):
            if r < r0 or r > r1 or c < c0 or c > c1:
                out[r][c] = inset
    return out

def _demo_check():
    g = [[0]*19 for _ in range(13)]
    for r in range(2,10):
        for c in range(2,9): g[r][c]=4
    for r in range(4,8):
        for c in range(4,7): g[r][c]=5
    o=transform(g)
    assert all(o[r][c]==5 for r in range(12) for c in range(11) if r<2 or r>9 or c<2 or c>8)
    assert all(o[r][c]==g[r][c] for r in range(13) for c in range(19) if 2<=r<=9 and 2<=c<=8)
_demo_check()
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
